rule: Preserve each old requirement. Add context beside the action it governs. Do not weaken an owner, veto, proof gate, or model boundary.

records.source_meaning: Keep the product clear without hiding truth, cost, risk, state, control, owners, or model judgment.
records.proof: The same outcome, owner pins, review ownership, and script boundary remain. Route files now bind context to each action.

records.source_meaning: Keep help read-only, keep run modes distinct, and use real success and failure examples.
records.proof: Both commands, mode limits, run example, and missing-proof stop remain. A generated context packet example and two record fixtures were added.

records.source_meaning: Freeze intake and owners, keep run state outside the skill, load run context, and bar script judgment.
records.proof: All start gates remain. The start now freezes the route hash, and each packet names the run files it needs.

records.source_meaning: Run all thirteen actions in the fixed workflow order with their named owners.
records.proof: Each old action appears once in the same order. Each capsule names Read, Run, Use, Compare, Test, Produce, and a barred substitution.

records.source_meaning: Load full packet context, make at least four unlike options, keep exploration open, and leave the choice with the model.
records.proof: The option floor, open option space, option fields, and model choice remain. Required paths and missing-context accounting were added.

records.source_meaning: Treat product states as an open context-derived set with overlap, change, causes, and uncertainty.
records.proof: The open-set rule, prompt-only state list, discovery inputs, overlap, change, and uncertainty remain.

records.source_meaning: The model must run every exact eye, brain, touch, objective, bad design, bad output, and bad work check against current proof.
records.proof: All seven groups remain. Each answer still needs scene, observation, evidence, decision, reason, alternatives, and doubt.

records.source_meaning: Build through the fixed low-to-high part chain, require token and atom proof, and rebuild stale dependents.
records.proof: The chain, dtcg-tokens owner, atom gate, stale propagation, rebuild, and structural-only lineage claim remain.

records.source_meaning: Use the right record schema, validate fixed fields and checks, and keep design judgment with the model.
records.proof: All three schemas and the record command remain. Context acknowledgement and missing-context fields were added to each model schema.

records.source_meaning: Keep the veto order, do not hide burden, and block only affected claims with an exact resume path.
records.proof: The veto order, non-tradeable limits, failure owner, partial block, safe work, and resume proof remain.

records.source_meaning: Keep reading, file, generation, package, task, validation, owner, and source claims with one named owner each.
records.proof: All old owners remain. Context route assets, checker, and generated example owners were added without a second owner.

records.source_meaning: Keep eval method, grading, cases, triggers, timing, source proof, fixtures, and fixture claim limits with named owners.
records.proof: All prior eval owners remain. One context-loss case per workflow action and pass and block fixtures were added.

records.source_meaning: Return product and proof, use only three final states, avoid overclaims, run all gates, and pass only with current seen proof.
records.proof: The return scope, three states, no-overclaim rule, run check, CI gate, seen-view gate, and veto gate remain. Context accounting is now also required.
